summary: Investcorp Credit Management BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, announcing it retained Houlihan Lokey Capital, Inc. as financial advisor to assist the Special Committee of Independent Directors in its ongoing review of strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value. No specific terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The board has not set a timetable and has not made any decisions, with no assurance of a transaction. The filing is a strategic review announcement, not a definitive deal. Watch for future filings on potential sale, merger, or other outcomes; no risk-arb angle yet.
